content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

Lower back pain after deadlifts is a signal to back off. Drop the load, or skip deadlifts for now, until movement feels pain-free. Normal muscle tiredness is fine. Sharp, lasting, or radiating pain (down the leg, or with numbness or tingling) means you should stop and see a doctor or physio.

💡 When you do go back to them, use a lighter weight, keep your back neutral, and keep the bar close to your body. Don't push through pain.
